title: Dinners on a Plan That Does Not Fund Three Meal Periods
content:
Where an Employee Meal Account is held on a plan funding fewer than three meal periods a day, dinners rung on the account come out of the pot a ticket may draw on. The single dinner relief is $1.50.

**Clause.** Where the plan funds fewer than three meal periods a day and two or more dinners have been rung on the account in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the amount taken out is the whole value of those dinners. Where the plan funds fewer than three meal periods a day and exactly one dinner has been rung on the account in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the amount taken out is that dinner less the single dinner relief, never read as less than nothing. Where neither holds, nothing is taken out for meals outside the funded periods.

## Meal periods funded, plan by plan

| Meal plan | Meal periods a day at which allowance may be spent |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | 0 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | 0 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | 0 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | 2 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | 3 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | 3 |

## The bands

| Meal periods the plan funds | Dinners rung in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | Taken out of the pot |
|---|---|---|
| Fewer than 3 | 2 or more | The whole value of those dinners |
| Fewer than 3 | Exactly 1 | That dinner less $1.50, and never below nothing |
| Fewer than 3 | None | Nothing |
| 3 or more | Any | Nothing |

*Hypothetical illustration.* On a plan funding 2 meal periods a day, 3 dinners in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked worth $38.00 together take $38.00 out of the pot; a single dinner of $11.00 takes $9.50 out; a single dinner of $1.20 takes nothing out, since $1.20 less $1.50 is never read as less than nothing. On a plan funding 3 meal periods a day, dinners take nothing out.
